component.name: Andromeda Music
component.summary: High-performance music player and ambient video visualizer

description.p: Andromeda Music is a native, modern, open-source Linux music player designed from the ground up for high fidelity, cinematic ambiance, and rock-solid stability. It natively connects to self-hosted Navidrome and Subsonic music servers while seamlessly pulling and caching synchronized YouTube music videos.

Unlike web-wrapped Electron players that consume hundreds of megabytes of RAM and lack deep OS integration, Andromeda Music is written natively in Python 3 and PySide6 (Qt6). Utilizing direct hardware-accelerated Qt RHI / QML MultiEffect GLSL shaders, it delivers a live, blurred ambient backdrop with almost zero CPU overhead.

ul.li: Hi-Fi lossless audio streaming (FLAC, ALAC, Opus, AAC, MP3) with direct playback
Hardware-accelerated ambient video blurring powered by QML MultiEffect GLSL shaders
Automatic Resolution Fallback (ARF 3.1) preventing audio stutter during network lag
Offline storage and transfer manager with multi-server cache partitioning
Full Linux desktop integration via MPRIS2, PipeWire audio routing, and XDG standards
Optimized for both desktop environments (KDE, GNOME) and tiling window managers (Hyprland, Sway)

screenshot.caption: Cinematic playback view with live hardware-accelerated ambient video blur
Responsive music library and albums view
Zenith-style offline download and storage center

ul.li: Hi-Fi direct audio streaming without forced server-side transcoding
Hardware-accelerated QML MultiEffect video ambient pipeline
Zenith-style transfer and storage center with multi-state filters
